class GELU(nn.Module):
    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.sigmoid(1.702 * x) * x


class SE(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, r=8):
        super().__init__()
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(c, c // r)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(c // r, c)
        self.act = GELU()

    def forward(self, x):
        s = x.mean(dim=-1)
        s = torch.sigmoid(self.fc2(self.act(self.fc1(s))))
        return x * s.unsqueeze(-1)


class Inception(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c):
        super().__init__()
        b = c // 4
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.act = GELU()
        self.b1 = nn.Conv1d(c, b, 1)
        self.b2 = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(c, b, 1), nn.BatchNorm1d(b), GELU(), nn.Conv1d(b, b, 5, padding=2))
        self.b3 = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(c, b, 1), nn.BatchNorm1d(b), GELU(), nn.Conv1d(b, b, 11, padding=5))
        self.b4 = nn.Sequential(nn.MaxPool1d(3, stride=1, padding=1), nn.Conv1d(c, b, 1))
        self.merge_bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(4 * b)
        self.merge = nn.Conv1d(4 * b, c, 1)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(0.05)
        self.se = SE(c)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.merge.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.merge.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.act(self.bn(x))
        h = torch.cat([self.b1(h), self.b2(h), self.b3(h), self.b4(h)], dim=1)
        h = self.merge(self.drop(self.act(self.merge_bn(h))))
        return x + self.se(h)


class InceptionNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_len, c1=128, c=256, n1=3, n2=3, local_ch=8, hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(4, c1, 15, padding=7), nn.BatchNorm1d(c1), GELU(), nn.MaxPool1d(2),
                                  nn.Conv1d(c1, c, 5, padding=2), nn.BatchNorm1d(c), GELU(), nn.MaxPool1d(2))
        self.stage1 = nn.Sequential(*[Inception(c) for _ in range(n1)])
        self.pool = nn.MaxPool1d(2)
        self.stage2 = nn.Sequential(*[Inception(c) for _ in range(n2)])
        self.post = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(c), GELU())
        L = ((input_len // 2) // 2) // 2
        self.local = nn.Conv1d(c, local_ch, 1)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * c + local_ch * L, hidden), GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.1), nn.Linear(hidden, 1))
        nn.init.constant_(self.head[-1].bias, 2.5)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.stage1(self.stem(x))
        h = self.post(self.stage2(self.pool(h)))
        g = torch.cat([h.max(dim=-1).values, h.mean(dim=-1)], dim=1)
        loc = self.local(h).flatten(1)
        out = self.head(torch.cat([g, loc], dim=1))
        return F.softplus(out.float()).reshape(-1)

# --- block: model ---
class GELU(nn.Module):
    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.sigmoid(1.702 * x) * x


class DynDilBlock(nn.Module):
    """Pre-activation dilated residual block whose k3 conv is a per-sample softmax mixture of K expert kernels."""

    def __init__(self, c, d, k_experts=4):
        super().__init__()
        self.c, self.k = c, k_experts
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.experts = nn.Conv1d(c, k_experts * c, 3, padding=d, dilation=d)
        self.route = nn.Linear(2 * c, k_experts)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.route.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.route.bias)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, 1)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.bias)
        self.act = GELU()
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(0.05)

    def forward(self, x):
        z = self.act(self.bn1(x))
        b, _, n = z.shape
        feat = torch.cat([z.float().mean(dim=-1), z.float().amax(dim=-1)], dim=1)
        with torch.autocast(device_type=z.device.type, enabled=False):

        out = self.head(torch.cat([g, loc], dim=1))
        return F.softplus(out.float()).reshape(-1)

    def __init__(self, c, d):
        super().__init__()
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, 3, padding=d, dilation=d)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, 1)
        self.act = GELU()
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(0.05)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.conv1(self.act(self.bn1(x)))
        h = self.conv2(self.drop(self.act(self.bn2(h))))
        return x + h


class FullResNet(nn.Module):
    """BPNet-style trunk: no pooling, single-base resolution throughout; dilations give ~520 bp of context."""

    def __init__(self, input_len, c=128, dilations=(1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128), local_ch=8, bin_size=8, hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(4, c, 11, padding=5), nn.BatchNorm1d(c), GELU(),
                                  nn.Conv1d(c, c, 5, padding=2))

        self.bin_size = bin_size
        nbins = input_len // bin_size
        self.local = nn.Conv1d(c, local_ch, 1)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * c + local_ch * nbins, hidden), GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.1), nn.Linear(hidden, 1))

        loc = F.avg_pool1d(self.local(h), self.bin_size, self.bin_size).flatten(1)
        out = self.head(torch.cat([g, loc], dim=1))
        return F.softplus(out.float()).reshape(-1)

    return FullResNet(input_len)

class GELU(nn.Module):
    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.sigmoid(1.702 * x) * x


class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, k=3, d=1, drop=0.05):
        super().__init__()
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, k, padding=d * (k // 2), dilation=d)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, 1)
        self.act = GELU()
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.conv1(self.act(self.bn1(x)))
        h = self.conv2(self.drop(self.act(self.bn2(h))))
        return x + h


class Down(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, cin, cout, k=5):
        super().__init__()
        self.f = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(cin), GELU(), nn.Conv1d(cin, cout, k, padding=k // 2), nn.MaxPool1d(2))

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.f(x)


class Up(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, cin, cskip, cout):
        super().__init__()
        self.f = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(cin + cskip), GELU(), nn.Conv1d(cin + cskip, cout, 3, padding=1))
        self.res = ResBlock(cout, 3, 1)

    def forward(self, x, skip):
        x = F.interpolate(x, size=skip.shape[-1], mode="nearest")
        return self.res(self.f(torch.cat([x, skip], dim=1)))


class UNet1D(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_len, c0=96, c1=128, c2=224, c3=256, local_ch=4, hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Conv1d(4, c0, 15, padding=7)
        self.e0 = ResBlock(c0, 5, 1)
        self.d1 = Down(c0, c1)
        self.e1 = ResBlock(c1, 5, 1)
        self.d2 = Down(c1, c2)
        self.e2 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(c2, 3, 1), ResBlock(c2, 3, 2))
        self.d3 = Down(c2, c3)
        self.bott = nn.Sequential(*[ResBlock(c3, 3, d) for d in (1, 2, 4, 8)])
        self.u2 = Up(c3, c2, c2)
        self.u1 = Up(c2, c1, c1)
        self.post = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(c1), GELU())
        self.bpost = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(c3), GELU())
        L1 = input_len // 2
        self.attn = nn.Conv1d(c1, 1, 1)
        self.pos_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 1, L1))
        self.local = nn.Conv1d(c1, local_ch, 1)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(c1 + 2 * c3 + local_ch * L1, hidden), GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.1),
                                  nn.Linear(hidden, 1))

    def forward(self, x):
        h0 = self.e0(self.stem(x))
        h1 = self.e1(self.d1(h0))
        h2 = self.e2(self.d2(h1))
        hb = self.bott(self.d3(h2))
        u = self.u1(self.u2(hb, h2), h1)
        u = self.post(u)
        logits = (self.attn(u).float() + self.pos_bias.float())
        w = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        pooled = (u.float() * w).sum(dim=-1)
        b = self.bpost(hb)
        g = torch.cat([b.max(dim=-1).values.float(), b.mean(dim=-1).float()], dim=1)
        loc = self.local(u).flatten(1).float()
        feats = torch.cat([pooled, g, loc], dim=1).to(u.dtype)
        out = self.head(feats)
        return F.softplus(out.float()).reshape(-1)


def build_model(input_len):
    return UNet1D(input_len)

class GELU(nn.Module):
    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.sigmoid(1.702 * x) * x


class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, k=3, d=1, drop=0.05):
        super().__init__()
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, k, padding=d * (k // 2), dilation=d)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, 1)
        self.act = GELU()
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.conv1(self.act(self.bn1(x)))
        h = self.conv2(self.drop(self.act(self.bn2(h))))
        return x + h


class Down(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, cin, cout, k=5):
        super().__init__()
        self.f = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(cin), GELU(), nn.Conv1d(cin, cout, k, padding=k // 2), nn.MaxPool1d(2))

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.f(x)


class SpectralMix(nn.Module):
    """FNO-style global mixing: channel mixing (block-diagonal, `groups` blocks) on the lowest `modes` frequencies.
    Zero-padded to 2L so the convolution is linear, not circular. Computed in fp32 with autocast off."""

    def __init__(self, c, modes=48, groups=8):
        super().__init__()
        self.g = groups
        self.cg = c // groups
        self.modes = modes
        scale = 0.5 / self.cg
        self.wr = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(groups, self.cg, self.cg, modes) * scale)
        self.wi = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(groups, self.cg, self.cg, modes) * scale)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, C, L = x.shape
        with torch.autocast(device_type=x.device.type, enabled=False):
            xf = torch.fft.rfft(x.float(), n=2 * L, dim=-1)
            m = min(self.modes, xf.shape[-1])
            xf = xf[..., :m].reshape(B, self.g, self.cg, m)
            w = torch.complex(self.wr[..., :m].float(), self.wi[..., :m].float())
            yf = torch.einsum("bgim,giom->bgom", xf, w).reshape(B, C, m)
            y = torch.fft.irfft(yf, n=2 * L, dim=-1)[..., :L]
        return y.to(x.dtype)


class FNOBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, d=1, modes=48, groups=8, drop=0.05):
        super().__init__()
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.act = GELU()
        self.local = nn.Conv1d(c, c, 3, padding=d, dilation=d)
        self.spec = SpectralMix(c, modes, groups)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop)
        self.out = nn.Conv1d(c, c, 1)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.out.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.out.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        a = self.act(self.bn1(x))
        h = self.local(a)
        h = h + self.spec(a).to(h.dtype)
        h = self.out(self.drop(self.act(self.bn2(h))))
        return x + h


class FNONet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_len, c0=128, c1=192, c=256, dilations=(1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 1), modes=48, groups=8,
                 local_ch=8, hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Conv1d(4, c0, 15, padding=7)
        self.e0 = ResBlock(c0, 5, 1)
        self.d1 = Down(c0, c1)
        self.e1 = ResBlock(c1, 5, 1)
        self.d2 = Down(c1, c)
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[FNOBlock(c, d, modes, groups) for d in dilations])
        self.post = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(c), GELU())
        L2 = (input_len // 2) // 2
        self.attn = nn.Conv1d(c, 1, 1)
        self.pos_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 1, L2))
        self.local = nn.Conv1d(c, local_ch, 1)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(3 * c + local_ch * L2, hidden), GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.1),
                                  nn.Linear(hidden, 1))
        nn.init.constant_(self.head[-1].bias, math.log(math.expm1(2.7)))

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.e0(self.stem(x))
        h = self.e1(self.d1(h))
        h = self.blocks(self.d2(h))
        u = self.post(h)
        logits = self.attn(u).float() + self.pos_bias.float()
        w = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        pooled = (u.float() * w).sum(dim=-1)
        g = torch.cat([u.max(dim=-1).values.float(), u.mean(dim=-1).float()], dim=1)
        loc = self.local(u).flatten(1).float()
        feats = torch.cat([pooled, g, loc], dim=1).to(u.dtype)
        out = self.head(feats)
        return F.softplus(out.float()).reshape(-1)

        h = self.conv2(self.drop(self.act(self.bn2(h))))
        return x + h


class Down(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, cin, cout, k=5):
        super().__init__()
        self.f = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(cin), GELU(), nn.Conv1d(cin, cout, k, padding=k // 2), nn.MaxPool1d(2))

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.f(x)


class PosReadout(nn.Module):
    """Attention pool with a learned per-position bias (meaningful under a 3'-anchored layout), plus max and mean."""

    def __init__(self, c, length):
        super().__init__()
        self.post = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(c), GELU())
        self.attn = nn.Conv1d(c, 1, 1)
        self.pos_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 1, length))

    def forward(self, x):
        u = self.post(x)
        logits = self.attn(u).float() + self.pos_bias.float()
        w = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        uf = u.float()
        pooled = (uf * w).sum(dim=-1)
        return torch.cat([pooled, uf.max(dim=-1).values, uf.mean(dim=-1)], dim=1), u


class AnchoredPyramid(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_len, c0=128, c1=128, c2=192, c3=256, local_ch=8, hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        L1 = input_len // 2
        L2 = L1 // 2
        L3 = L2 // 2
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(4, c0, 15, padding=7), ResBlock(c0, 5, 1))
        self.d1 = Down(c0, c1)
        self.s1 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(c1, 3, 1), ResBlock(c1, 3, 2))
        self.d2 = Down(c1, c2)
        self.s2 = nn.Sequential(*[ResBlock(c2, 3, d) for d in (1, 2, 4)])
        self.d3 = Down(c2, c3)
        self.s3 = nn.Sequential(*[ResBlock(c3, 3, d) for d in (1, 2, 4, 8)])
        self.r1 = PosReadout(c1, L1)
        self.r2 = PosReadout(c2, L2)
        self.r3 = PosReadout(c3, L3)
        self.local = nn.Conv1d(c3, local_ch, 1)
        nfeat = 3 * (c1 + c2 + c3) + local_ch * L3
        self.head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(nfeat, hidden), GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.1), nn.Linear(hidden, 1))
        nn.init.constant_(self.head[-1].bias, 2.5)

    def forward(self, x):
        h1 = self.s1(self.d1(self.stem(x)))
        h2 = self.s2(self.d2(h1))
        h3 = self.s3(self.d3(h2))
        f1, _ = self.r1(h1)
        f2, _ = self.r2(h2)
        f3, u3 = self.r3(h3)
        loc = self.local(u3).flatten(1).float()
        feats = torch.cat([f1, f2, f3, loc], dim=1).to(h3.dtype)
        out = self.head(feats)
        return F.softplus(out.float()).reshape(-1)


def build_model(input_len):
    return AnchoredPyramid(input_len)

models.hypothesis: Activity depends on where motifs sit relative to both fragment ends, and the right weighting of a motif changes with fragment length. In a 3'-anchored layout the 5' end moves with length. Making every residual block's normalisation an explicit function of length (and GC) through FiLM should let one trunk learn length-specific grammar more easily than inferring length from the N padding through deep receptive fields.

# --- block: model ---
class GELU(nn.Module):
    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.sigmoid(1.702 * x) * x


class FiLMRes(nn.Module):
    """Pre-activation dilated residual unit whose first normalisation is modulated by a global fragment embedding."""

    def __init__(self, c, d, e, drop=0.05):
        super().__init__()
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, 3, padding=d, dilation=d)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, 1)
        self.film = nn.Linear(e, 2 * c)
        self.act = GELU()
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.bias)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.film.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.film.bias)

    def forward(self, x, z):
        gb = self.film(z).unsqueeze(-1)
        g, b = gb.chunk(2, dim=1)
        h = self.bn1(x)
        h = h * (1 + g.to(h.dtype)) + b.to(h.dtype)
        h = self.conv1(self.act(h))
        h = self.conv2(self.drop(self.act(self.bn2(h))))
        return x + h


class FiLMNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_len, c1=128, c=256, e=128, dilations=(1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32), hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem1 = nn.Conv1d(4, c1, 15, padding=7)
        self.stem2 = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(c1), GELU(), nn.MaxPool1d(2),
                                   nn.Conv1d(c1, c, 5, padding=2), nn.MaxPool1d(2))
        nfreq = 6
        self.register_buffer("freqs", torch.tensor([2 * math.pi * k / 600.0 for k in range(1, nfreq + 1)]))
        self.cond = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(3 + 2 * nfreq, e), GELU(), nn.Linear(e, e), GELU())
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([FiLMRes(c, d, e) for d in dilations])
        self.post = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(c), GELU())
        L = (input_len // 2) // 2
        self.attn = nn.Conv1d(c, 1, 1)
        self.pos_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 1, L))
        self.head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(3 * c + e, hidden), GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.1), nn.Linear(hidden, 1))
        nn.init.constant_(self.head[-1].bias, 2.6)

    def _condition(self, x):
        xf = x.float()
        n = xf.sum(dim=(1, 2)).clamp(min=1.0)
        gc = (xf[:, 1].sum(-1) + xf[:, 2].sum(-1)) / n
        ang = n.unsqueeze(1) * self.freqs.unsqueeze(0)
        feats = torch.cat([(n / 600.0).unsqueeze(1), (torch.log(n) / 6.4).unsqueeze(1), gc.unsqueeze(1),
                           torch.sin(ang), torch.cos(ang)], dim=1)
        return self.cond(feats)

    def forward(self, x):
        z = self._condition(x)
        h = self.stem2(self.stem1(x))
        for blk in self.blocks:
            h = blk(h, z)
        h = self.post(h)
        logits = self.attn(h).float() + self.pos_bias.float()[..., :h.shape[-1]]
        w = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        hf = h.float()
        pooled = (hf * w).sum(dim=-1)
        feats = torch.cat([pooled, hf.max(dim=-1).values, hf.mean(dim=-1), z.float()], dim=1).to(h.dtype)
        out = self.head(feats)
        return F.softplus(out.float()).reshape(-1)


def build_model(input_len):
    return FiLMNet(input_len)

That lets the trunk see exact core-motif identities, including ones that a conv plus GELU cannot separate. # --- block: model ---
class GELU(nn.Module):
    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.sigmoid(1.702 * x) * x


class KmerEmbed(nn.Module):
    """Learned vector per k-mer starting at each position; k-mers touching N (padding) map to a zero vector."""

    def __init__(self, k=8, dim=128):
        super().__init__()
        self.k = k
        self.emb = nn.Embedding(4 ** k + 1, dim, padding_idx=0)
        nn.init.normal_(self.emb.weight, std=0.05)
        with torch.no_grad():
            self.emb.weight[0].zero_()
        self.register_buffer("powers", torch.tensor([4 ** j for j in range(k)], dtype=torch.long), persistent=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        b, _, n = x.shape
        valid = x.float().sum(1) > 0.5
        idx = x.float().argmax(1).long()
        idx = F.pad(idx, (0, self.k - 1), value=0)
        vp = F.pad(valid, (0, self.k - 1), value=False)
        kidx = torch.zeros((b, n), dtype=torch.long, device=x.device)
        kv = torch.ones((b, n), dtype=torch.bool, device=x.device)
        for j in range(self.k):
            kidx = kidx + idx[:, j:j + n] * (4 ** j)
            kv = kv & vp[:, j:j + n]
        tok = torch.where(kv, kidx + 1, torch.zeros_like(kidx))
        return self.emb(tok).transpose(1, 2)


class DilRes(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, k=3, d=1, drop=0.05):
        super().__init__()
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, k, padding=d * (k // 2), dilation=d)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, 1)
        self.act = GELU()
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.conv1(self.act(self.bn1(x)))
        h = self.conv2(self.drop(self.act(self.bn2(h))))
        return x + h


class KmerNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_len, k=8, c0=128, c1=192, c=256, dilations=(1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32), local_ch=8, hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.kmer = KmerEmbed(k, c0)
        self.conv0 = nn.Conv1d(4, c0, 15, padding=7)
        self.emb_drop = nn.Dropout(0.05)
        self.r0 = DilRes(c0, 5, 1)
        self.down1 = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(c0), GELU(), nn.Conv1d(c0, c1, 5, padding=2), nn.MaxPool1d(2))
        self.down2 = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(c1), GELU(), nn.Conv1d(c1, c, 5, padding=2), nn.MaxPool1d(2))
        self.trunk = nn.Sequential(*[DilRes(c, 3, d) for d in dilations])
        self.post = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(c), GELU())
        L = input_len // 4
        self.attn = nn.Conv1d(c, 1, 1)
        self.pos_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 1, L))
        self.local = nn.Conv1d(c, local_ch, 1)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(3 * c + local_ch * L, hidden), GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.1), nn.Linear(hidden, 1))

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.conv0(x)
        e = self.emb_drop(self.kmer(x)).to(h.dtype)
        h = self.r0(h + e)
        h = self.trunk(self.down2(self.down1(h)))
        u = self.post(h)
        logits = self.attn(u).float() + self.pos_bias.float()
        w = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        uf = u.float()
        pooled = (uf * w).sum(dim=-1)
        mx = uf.max(dim=-1).values
        mn = uf.mean(dim=-1)
        loc = self.local(u).flatten(1).float()
        feats = torch.cat([pooled, mx, mn, loc], dim=1).to(u.dtype)
        out = self.head(feats)
        return F.softplus(out.float()).reshape(-1)


def build_model(input_len):
    return KmerNet(input_len)

# --- block: model ---
class GELU(nn.Module):
    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.sigmoid(1.702 * x) * x


class PreBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, d):
        super().__init__()
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, 3, padding=d, dilation=d)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, 1)
        self.act = GELU()
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(0.05)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.conv1(self.act(self.bn1(x)))
        h = self.conv2(self.drop(self.act(self.bn2(h))))
        return x + h


class Down(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, cin, cout, steps, zero=False):
        super().__init__()
        layers, c = [], cin
        for _ in range(steps):
            layers += [nn.BatchNorm1d(c), GELU(), nn.Conv1d(c, cout, 3, stride=2, padding=1)]
            c = cout
        self.f = nn.Sequential(*layers)
        if zero:
            nn.init.zeros_(layers[-1].weight)
            nn.init.zeros_(layers[-1].bias)

    def forward(self, x, size):
        h = self.f(x)
        if h.shape[-1] != size:
            h = F.interpolate(h, size=size, mode="nearest")
        return h


class Up(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, cin, cout):
        super().__init__()
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(cin)
        self.act = GELU()
        self.conv = nn.Conv1d(cin, cout, 1)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv.bias)

    def forward(self, x, size):
        h = self.conv(self.act(self.bn(x)))
        return F.interpolate(h, size=size, mode="nearest")


class Fuse(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, chs):
        super().__init__()
        self.n = len(chs)
        self.paths = nn.ModuleDict()
        for j in range(self.n):
            for i in range(self.n):
                if i == j:
                    continue
                if i > j:
                    self.paths[f"{i}_{j}"] = Up(chs[i], chs[j])
                else:
                    self.paths[f"{i}_{j}"] = Down(chs[i], chs[j], j - i, zero=True)

    def forward(self, xs):
        outs = []
        for j in range(self.n):
            y = xs[j]
            size = xs[j].shape[-1]
            for i in range(self.n):
                if i != j:
                    y = y + self.paths[f"{i}_{j}"](xs[i], size)
            outs.append(y)
        return outs


def _stage(c, dils):
    return nn.Sequential(*[PreBlock(c, d) for d in dils])


class HRNet1D(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_len, c0=128, chs=(160, 192, 256), local_ch=8, hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(4, c0, 15, padding=7), nn.BatchNorm1d(c0), GELU(), nn.MaxPool1d(2),
                                  nn.Conv1d(c0, chs[0], 5, padding=2), nn.BatchNorm1d(chs[0]), GELU(), nn.MaxPool1d(2))
        h, m, l = chs
        # stage 1: high only, then create mid
        self.s1_h = _stage(h, (1, 2))
        self.t1 = Down(h, m, 1)
        # stage 2: high + mid, fuse, then create low
        self.s2_h = _stage(h, (4, 8))
        self.s2_m = _stage(m, (1, 2))
        self.f2 = Fuse((h, m))
        self.t2 = Down(m, l, 1)
        # stage 3: three branches, fuse
        self.s3_h = _stage(h, (16, 32))
        self.s3_m = _stage(m, (4, 8))
        self.s3_l = _stage(l, (1, 2))
        self.f3 = Fuse((h, m, l))
        # stage 4: three branches, fuse
        self.s4_h = _stage(h, (2, 8))
        self.s4_m = _stage(m, (16, 1))
        self.s4_l = _stage(l, (4, 8))
        self.f4 = Fuse((h, m, l))
        self.post = nn.ModuleList([nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(c), GELU()) for c in chs])
        L = (input_len // 2) // 2
        self.local = nn.Conv1d(h, local_ch, 1)
        feat = 2 * (h + m + l) + local_ch * L
        self.head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(feat, hidden), GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.1), nn.Linear(hidden, 1))

    def forward(self, x):
        xh = self.s1_h(self.stem(x))
        xm = self.t1(xh, (xh.shape[-1] + 1) // 2)
        xh, xm = self.s2_h(xh), self.s2_m(xm)
        xh, xm = self.f2([xh, xm])
        xl = self.t2(xm, (xm.shape[-1] + 1) // 2)
        xh, xm, xl = self.s3_h(xh), self.s3_m(xm), self.s3_l(xl)
        xh, xm, xl = self.f3([xh, xm, xl])
        xh, xm, xl = self.s4_h(xh), self.s4_m(xm), self.s4_l(xl)
        xs = self.f4([xh, xm, xl])
        xs = [p(t) for p, t in zip(self.post, xs)]
        g = [torch.cat([t.max(dim=-1).values, t.mean(dim=-1)], dim=1) for t in xs]
        loc = self.local(xs[0]).flatten(1)
        out = self.head(torch.cat(g + [loc], dim=1))
        return F.softplus(out.float()).reshape(-1)


def build_model(input_len):
    return HRNet1D(input_len)

# --- block: model ---
class GELU(nn.Module):
    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.sigmoid(1.702 * x) * x


class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, k=3, d=1, drop=0.05):
        super().__init__()
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, k, padding=d * (k // 2), dilation=d)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, 1)
        self.act = GELU()
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.conv1(self.act(self.bn1(x)))
        h = self.conv2(self.drop(self.act(self.bn2(h))))
        return x + h


class Down(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, cin, cout, k=5):
        super().__init__()
        self.f = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(cin), GELU(), nn.Conv1d(cin, cout, k, padding=k // 2), nn.MaxPool1d(2))

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.f(x)


class DeformBlock(nn.Module):
    """Pre-activation residual block whose k-tap dilated conv samples at learned fractional offsets (DCNv2-style)."""

    def __init__(self, c, d, k=3, drop=0.05):
        super().__init__()
        self.k, self.d = k, d
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.act = GELU()
        self.off = nn.Conv1d(c, k, 3, padding=1)
        self.msk = nn.Conv1d(c, k, 3, padding=1)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.off.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.off.bias)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.msk.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.msk.bias)
        self.proj = nn.Conv1d(c * k, c, 1)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, 1)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.act(self.bn1(x))
        B, C, L = h.shape
        K = self.k
        off = self.off(h).float()
        m = 2.0 * torch.sigmoid(self.msk(h).float())
        taps = (torch.arange(K, device=h.device, dtype=torch.float32) - K // 2) * self.d
        base = torch.arange(L, device=h.device, dtype=torch.float32)
        pos = base.view(1, 1, L) + taps.view(1, K, 1) + off
        p0 = torch.floor(pos)
        w1 = pos - p0
        w0 = 1.0 - w1
        p1 = p0 + 1.0
        v0m = ((p0 >= 0) & (p0 <= L - 1)).float()
        v1m = ((p1 >= 0) & (p1 <= L - 1)).float()
        i0 = p0.clamp(0, L - 1).long().reshape(B, 1, K * L).expand(B, C, K * L)
        i1 = p1.clamp(0, L - 1).long().reshape(B, 1, K * L).expand(B, C, K * L)
        a0 = (w0 * v0m * m).reshape(B, 1, K * L).to(h.dtype)
        a1 = (w1 * v1m * m).reshape(B, 1, K * L).to(h.dtype)
        s = torch.gather(h, 2, i0) * a0 + torch.gather(h, 2, i1) * a1
        s = s.reshape(B, C, K, L).reshape(B, C * K, L)
        h = self.proj(s)
        h = self.conv2(self.drop(self.act(self.bn2(h))))
        return x + h


class DeformNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_len, c0=128, c1=192, c=256, dilations=(1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32), local_ch=8, hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Conv1d(4, c0, 15, padding=7)
        self.e0 = ResBlock(c0, 5, 1)
        self.d1 = Down(c0, c1)
        self.e1 = ResBlock(c1, 5, 1)
        self.d2 = Down(c1, c)
        self.trunk = nn.Sequential(*[DeformBlock(c, d) for d in dilations])
        self.post = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(c), GELU())
        L = (input_len // 2) // 2
        self.attn = nn.Conv1d(c, 1, 1)
        self.pos_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 1, L))
        self.local = nn.Conv1d(c, local_ch, 1)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(3 * c + local_ch * L, hidden), GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.1), nn.Linear(hidden, 1))

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.e0(self.stem(x))
        h = self.e1(self.d1(h))
        h = self.trunk(self.d2(h))
        u = self.post(h)
        logits = self.attn(u).float() + self.pos_bias.float()
        w = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        pooled = (u.float() * w).sum(dim=-1)
        g = torch.cat([u.max(dim=-1).values.float(), u.mean(dim=-1).float()], dim=1)
        loc = self.local(u).flatten(1).float()
        feats = torch.cat([pooled, g, loc], dim=1).to(u.dtype)
        out = self.head(feats)
        return F.softplus(out.float()).reshape(-1)


def build_model(input_len):
    return DeformNet(input_len)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.f(x)


class PoolBlock(nn.Module):
    """MetaFormer block whose token mixer is average pooling minus identity (PoolFormer)."""

    def __init__(self, c, k=3, ratio=4, drop=0.05):
        super().__init__()
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.pool = nn.AvgPool1d(k, stride=1, padding=k // 2, count_include_pad=False)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.fc1 = nn.Conv1d(c, ratio * c, 1)
        self.fc2 = nn.Conv1d(ratio * c, c, 1)
        self.act = GELU()
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop)
        self.ls1 = nn.Parameter(torch.full((1, c, 1), 0.1))
        self.ls2 = nn.Parameter(torch.full((1, c, 1), 0.1))
        nn.init.zeros_(self.fc2.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.bn1(x)
        x = x + self.ls1 * (self.pool(h) - h)
        h = self.fc2(self.drop(self.act(self.fc1(self.bn2(x)))))
        return x + self.ls2 * h


class PoolFormer1D(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_len, c0=128, c1=192, c=256, n1=6, n2=6, local_ch=8, hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Conv1d(4, c0, 15, padding=7)
        self.d1 = Down(c0, c1, 5)
        self.d2 = Down(c1, c, 5)
        self.s1 = nn.Sequential(*[PoolBlock(c, 3) for _ in range(n1)])
        self.d3 = Down(c, c, 3)
        self.s2 = nn.Sequential(*[PoolBlock(c, 5) for _ in range(n2)])
        L1 = (input_len // 2) // 2
        self.post1 = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(c), GELU())
        self.post2 = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(c), GELU())
        self.attn = nn.Conv1d(c, 1, 1)

        self.head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(c + 2 * c + local_ch * L1, hidden), GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.1),
                                  nn.Linear(hidden, 1))

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.d2(self.d1(self.stem(x)))
        h1 = self.s1(h)
        h2 = self.s2(self.d3(h1))
        u = self.post1(h1)

        return torch.sigmoid(1.702 * x) * x


class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, k=3, d=1, drop=0.05):
        super().__init__()
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, k, padding=d * (k // 2), dilation=d)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, 1)
        self.act = GELU()
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.conv1(self.act(self.bn1(x)))
        h = self.conv2(self.drop(self.act(self.bn2(h))))
        return x + h


class Down(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, cin, cout, k=5):
        super().__init__()
        self.f = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(cin), GELU(), nn.Conv1d(cin, cout, k, padding=k // 2), nn.MaxPool1d(2))

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.f(x)


class DirBlock(nn.Module):
    """Residual block with a causal (5'->3', sees upstream only) and an anticausal (sees downstream only) dilated branch."""

    def __init__(self, c, d, k=3, drop=0.05):
        super().__init__()
        self.d = d
        self.k = k
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.fwd = nn.Conv1d(c, c // 2, k, dilation=d)
        self.bwd = nn.Conv1d(c, c - c // 2, k, dilation=d)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, 1)
        self.act = GELU()
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.act(self.bn1(x))
        p = self.d * (self.k - 1)
        f = self.fwd(F.pad(h, (p, 0)))
        b = self.bwd(F.pad(h, (0, p)))
        h = torch.cat([f, b], dim=1)
        h = self.conv2(self.drop(self.act(self.bn2(h))))
        return x + h


class DirTCN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_len, c0=128, c1=192, c=256, dilations=(1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32), local_ch=4, hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Conv1d(4, c0, 15, padding=7)

        self.d1 = Down(c0, c1)
        self.d2 = Down(c1, c)

        self.head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(3 * c + local_ch * L, hidden), GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.1),
                                  nn.Linear(hidden, 1))

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.e0(self.stem(x))

        u = self.post(h)

class GELU(nn.Module):
    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.sigmoid(1.702 * x) * x


class FiLMRes(nn.Module):
    """Pre-activation dilated residual unit whose first normalisation is modulated by a global fragment embedding."""

    def __init__(self, c, d, e, drop=0.05):
        super().__init__()
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, 3, padding=d, dilation=d)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, 1)
        self.film = nn.Linear(e, 2 * c)
        self.act = GELU()
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.bias)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.film.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.film.bias)

    def forward(self, x, z):
        gb = self.film(z).unsqueeze(-1)
        g, b = gb.chunk(2, dim=1)
        h = self.bn1(x)
        h = h * (1 + g.to(h.dtype)) + b.to(h.dtype)
        h = self.conv1(self.act(h))
        h = self.conv2(self.drop(self.act(self.bn2(h))))
        return x + h


class FiLMNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_len, c1=192, c=320, e=128, dilations=(1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32), hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem1 = nn.Conv1d(4, c1, 15, padding=7)
        self.stem2 = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(c1), GELU(), nn.MaxPool1d(2),
                                   nn.Conv1d(c1, c, 5, padding=2), nn.MaxPool1d(2))
        nfreq = 6
        self.register_buffer("freqs", torch.tensor([2 * math.pi * k / 600.0 for k in range(1, nfreq + 1)]))
        self.cond = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(3 + 2 * nfreq, e), GELU(), nn.Linear(e, e), GELU())
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([FiLMRes(c, d, e) for d in dilations])
        self.post = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(c), GELU())
        L = (input_len // 2) // 2
        self.attn = nn.Conv1d(c, 1, 1)
        self.pos_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 1, L))
        self.head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(3 * c + e, hidden), GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.1), nn.Linear(hidden, 1))
        nn.init.constant_(self.head[-1].bias, 2.6)

    def _condition(self, x):
        xf = x.float()
        n = xf.sum(dim=(1, 2)).clamp(min=1.0)
        gc = (xf[:, 1].sum(-1) + xf[:, 2].sum(-1)) / n
        ang = n.unsqueeze(1) * self.freqs.unsqueeze(0)
        feats = torch.cat([(n / 600.0).unsqueeze(1), (torch.log(n) / 6.4).unsqueeze(1), gc.unsqueeze(1),
                           torch.sin(ang), torch.cos(ang)], dim=1)
        return self.cond(feats)

    def forward(self, x):
        z = self._condition(x)
        h = self.stem2(self.stem1(x))
        for blk in self.blocks:
            h = blk(h, z)
        h = self.post(h)
        logits = self.attn(h).float() + self.pos_bias.float()[..., :h.shape[-1]]
        w = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        hf = h.float()
        pooled = (hf * w).sum(dim=-1)
        feats = torch.cat([pooled, hf.max(dim=-1).values, hf.mean(dim=-1), z.float()], dim=1).to(h.dtype)
        out = self.head(feats)
        return F.softplus(out.float()).reshape(-1)


def build_model(input_len):
    return FiLMNet(input_len)

    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.sigmoid(1.702 * x) * x


class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, k=3, d=1, drop=0.05):
        super().__init__()
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, k, padding=d * (k // 2), dilation=d)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, 1)
        self.act = GELU()
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.conv1(self.act(self.bn1(x)))
        h = self.conv2(self.drop(self.act(self.bn2(h))))
        return x + h


class Down(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, cin, cout, k=5):
        super().__init__()
        self.f = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(cin), GELU(), nn.Conv1d(cin, cout, k, padding=k // 2), nn.MaxPool1d(2))

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.f(x)


class PosReadout(nn.Module):
    """Attention pool with a learned per-position bias (meaningful under a 3'-anchored layout), plus max and mean."""

    def __init__(self, c, length):
        super().__init__()
        self.post = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(c), GELU())
        self.attn = nn.Conv1d(c, 1, 1)
        self.pos_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 1, length))

    def forward(self, x):
        u = self.post(x)
        logits = self.attn(u).float() + self.pos_bias.float()
        w = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        uf = u.float()
        pooled = (uf * w).sum(dim=-1)
        return torch.cat([pooled, uf.max(dim=-1).values, uf.mean(dim=-1)], dim=1), u


class AnchoredPyramid(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_len, c0=128, c1=128, c2=256, c3=320, local_ch=8, hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        L1 = input_len // 2
        L2 = L1 // 2
        L3 = L2 // 2
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(4, c0, 15, padding=7), ResBlock(c0, 5, 1))
        self.d1 = Down(c0, c1)
        self.s1 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(c1, 3, 1), ResBlock(c1, 3, 2))
        self.d2 = Down(c1, c2)
        self.s2 = nn.Sequential(*[ResBlock(c2, 3, d) for d in (1, 2, 4)])
        self.d3 = Down(c2, c3)
        self.s3 = nn.Sequential(*[ResBlock(c3, 3, d) for d in (1, 2, 4, 8)])
        self.r1 = PosReadout(c1, L1)
        self.r2 = PosReadout(c2, L2)
        self.r3 = PosReadout(c3, L3)
        self.local = nn.Conv1d(c3, local_ch, 1)
        nfeat = 3 * (c1 + c2 + c3) + local_ch * L3
        self.head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(nfeat, hidden), GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.1), nn.Linear(hidden, 1))
        nn.init.constant_(self.head[-1].bias, 2.5)

        feats = torch.cat([f1, f2, f3, loc], dim=1).to(h3.dtype)
        out = self.head(feats)
        return F.softplus(out.float()).reshape(-1)

    return AnchoredPyramid(input_len)

models.hypothesis: Promoter activity depends on combinations of motifs. First-order pools (max, mean, attention) give a linear head only per-channel summaries, so it must infer co-occurrence indirectly. A low-rank asymmetric covariance of trunk features over positions (G = P Q^T / L) gives the head direct pairwise channel co-occurrence, including which feature tends to sit near which.

# --- block: model ---
class GELU(nn.Module):
    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.sigmoid(1.702 * x) * x


class DilBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, d, drop=0.05):
        super().__init__()
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, 3, padding=d, dilation=d)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, 1)
        self.act = GELU()
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.conv1(self.act(self.bn1(x)))
        h = self.conv2(self.drop(self.act(self.bn2(h))))
        return x + h


class CovPool(nn.Module):
    """Low-rank asymmetric second-order pooling: G = P Q^T / L over positions, signed sqrt, LayerNorm."""

    def __init__(self, c, r=48):
        super().__init__()
        self.p = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(c, r, 1), nn.BatchNorm1d(r))
        self.q = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(c, r, 1), nn.BatchNorm1d(r))
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(r * r)
        self.r = r

    def forward(self, u):
        p = self.p(u)
        q = self.q(u)
        with torch.autocast(device_type=u.device.type, enabled=False):
            p = p.float()
            q = q.float()
            g = torch.bmm(p, q.transpose(1, 2)) / p.shape[-1]
            g = g.flatten(1)
            g = torch.sign(g) * torch.sqrt(g.abs() + 1e-4)
            g = self.norm(g)
        return g


class CovNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_len, c1=128, c=256, dilations=(1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32), local_ch=8, rank=48, hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(4, c1, 15, padding=7), nn.BatchNorm1d(c1), GELU(), nn.MaxPool1d(2),
                                  nn.Conv1d(c1, c, 5, padding=2), nn.BatchNorm1d(c), GELU(), nn.MaxPool1d(2))
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[DilBlock(c, d) for d in dilations])
        self.post = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(c), GELU())
        L = (input_len // 2) // 2
        self.local = nn.Conv1d(c, local_ch, 1)
        self.cov = CovPool(c, rank)
        nfeat = 2 * c + local_ch * L + rank * rank
        self.head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(nfeat, hidden), GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.1), nn.Linear(hidden, 1))
        nn.init.constant_(self.head[-1].bias, 2.5)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.post(self.blocks(self.stem(x)))
        hf = h.float()
        g = torch.cat([hf.max(dim=-1).values, hf.mean(dim=-1)], dim=1)
        loc = self.local(h).flatten(1).float()
        cov = self.cov(h)
        feats = torch.cat([g, loc, cov], dim=1).to(h.dtype)
        out = self.head(feats)
        return F.softplus(out.float()).reshape(-1)


def build_model(input_len):
    return CovNet(input_len)

# --- block: model ---
class GELU(nn.Module):
    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.sigmoid(1.702 * x) * x


class RCConv(nn.Module):
    """RC-equivariant conv: output channels are [a, b] with b the reverse-complement partner of a.
    The input is one-hot (RC = flip ACGT order) or paired channels (RC = swap halves)."""

    def __init__(self, cin, cout, k, d=1, onehot_in=False):
        super().__init__()
        assert cout % 2 == 0
        self.k, self.d = k, d
        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(cout // 2, cin, k))
        self.bias = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(cout // 2))
        nn.init.kaiming_uniform_(self.weight, a=math.sqrt(5))
        bound = 1.0 / math.sqrt(cin * k)
        nn.init.uniform_(self.bias, -bound, bound)
        if onehot_in:
            perm = torch.arange(cin - 1, -1, -1)
        else:
            h = cin // 2
            perm = torch.cat([torch.arange(h, 2 * h), torch.arange(0, h)])
        self.register_buffer("perm", perm, persistent=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        w = self.weight
        w_rc = w.index_select(1, self.perm).flip(2)
        wf = torch.cat([w, w_rc], 0)
        bf = torch.cat([self.bias, self.bias], 0)
        return F.conv1d(x, wf, bf, padding=self.d * (self.k // 2), dilation=self.d)


class PairBN(nn.Module):
    """BatchNorm whose statistics and affine are shared within each forward/RC channel pair."""

    def __init__(self, c):
        super().__init__()
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(c // 2)

    def forward(self, x):
        b, c, n = x.shape
        return self.bn(x.reshape(b * 2, c // 2, n)).reshape(b, c, n)


class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, k=3, d=1, drop=0.05):
        super().__init__()
        self.bn1 = PairBN(c)
        self.conv1 = RCConv(c, c, k, d)
        self.bn2 = PairBN(c)
        self.conv2 = RCConv(c, c, 1)
        self.act = GELU()
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.conv1(self.act(self.bn1(x)))
        h = self.conv2(self.drop(self.act(self.bn2(h))))
        return x + h


class Down(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, cin, cout, k=5):
        super().__init__()
        self.f = nn.Sequential(PairBN(cin), GELU(), RCConv(cin, cout, k), nn.MaxPool1d(2))

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.f(x)


class PosReadout(nn.Module):
    """Directional (untied) readout: attention pool with a learned per-position bias, plus max and mean."""

    def __init__(self, c, length):
        super().__init__()
        self.post = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(c), GELU())
        self.attn = nn.Conv1d(c, 1, 1)
        self.pos_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 1, length))

    def forward(self, x):
        u = self.post(x)
        logits = self.attn(u).float() + self.pos_bias.float()
        w = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        uf = u.float()
        pooled = (uf * w).sum(dim=-1)
        return torch.cat([pooled, uf.max(dim=-1).values, uf.mean(dim=-1)], dim=1), u


class RCEquivariantPyramid(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_len, c0=128, c1=128, c2=192, c3=256, local_ch=8, hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        L1 = input_len // 2
        L2 = L1 // 2
        L3 = L2 // 2
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(RCConv(4, c0, 15, onehot_in=True), ResBlock(c0, 5, 1))
        self.d1 = Down(c0, c1)
        self.s1 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(c1, 3, 1), ResBlock(c1, 3, 2))
        self.d2 = Down(c1, c2)
        self.s2 = nn.Sequential(*[ResBlock(c2, 3, d) for d in (1, 2, 4)])
        self.d3 = Down(c2, c3)
        self.s3 = nn.Sequential(*[ResBlock(c3, 3, d) for d in (1, 2, 4, 8)])
        self.r1 = PosReadout(c1, L1)
        self.r2 = PosReadout(c2, L2)
        self.r3 = PosReadout(c3, L3)
        self.local = nn.Conv1d(c3, local_ch, 1)
        nfeat = 3 * (c1 + c2 + c3) + local_ch * L3
        self.head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(nfeat, hidden), GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.1), nn.Linear(hidden, 1))
        nn.init.constant_(self.head[-1].bias, 2.5)

    def forward(self, x):
        h1 = self.s1(self.d1(self.stem(x)))
        h2 = self.s2(self.d2(h1))
        h3 = self.s3(self.d3(h2))
        f1, _ = self.r1(h1)
        f2, _ = self.r2(h2)
        f3, u3 = self.r3(h3)
        loc = self.local(u3).flatten(1).float()
        feats = torch.cat([f1, f2, f3, loc], dim=1).to(h3.dtype)
        out = self.head(feats)
        return F.softplus(out.float()).reshape(-1)


def build_model(input_len):
    return RCEquivariantPyramid(input_len)

models.name: fno-spectral-dilated-hybrid
models.hypothesis: The FNO lineage differs from the plain dilated nets through its global spectral mix. With 8 groups of 32 channels, that mix can only combine motif channels within the same 32-channel block over long range, which limits the long-range combinations of motifs it can model. Using 4 groups of 64 channels doubles the cross-channel reach of the global path. It costs little: the einsum is about 3M MACs per block per sample against about 500M for the whole net. This is the capacity-in-the-trunk direction that widening has rewarded in S46 and S38, applied to the part unique to this structure and kept inside the compute limit.

# --- block: model ---
class GELU(nn.Module):
    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.sigmoid(1.702 * x) * x


class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, k=3, d=1, drop=0.05):
        super().__init__()
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, k, padding=d * (k // 2), dilation=d)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, 1)
        self.act = GELU()
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.conv1(self.act(self.bn1(x)))
        h = self.conv2(self.drop(self.act(self.bn2(h))))
        return x + h


class Down(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, cin, cout, k=5):
        super().__init__()
        self.f = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(cin), GELU(), nn.Conv1d(cin, cout, k, padding=k // 2), nn.MaxPool1d(2))

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.f(x)


class SpectralMix(nn.Module):
    """FNO-style global mixing: channel mixing (block-diagonal, `groups` blocks) on the lowest `modes` frequencies.
    Zero-padded to 2L so the convolution is linear, not circular. Computed in fp32 with autocast off."""

    def __init__(self, c, modes=48, groups=4):
        super().__init__()
        self.g = groups
        self.cg = c // groups
        self.modes = modes
        scale = 0.5 / self.cg
        self.wr = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(groups, self.cg, self.cg, modes) * scale)
        self.wi = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(groups, self.cg, self.cg, modes) * scale)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, C, L = x.shape
        with torch.autocast(device_type=x.device.type, enabled=False):
            xf = torch.fft.rfft(x.float(), n=2 * L, dim=-1)
            m = min(self.modes, xf.shape[-1])
            xf = xf[..., :m].reshape(B, self.g, self.cg, m)
            w = torch.complex(self.wr[..., :m].float(), self.wi[..., :m].float())
            yf = torch.einsum("bgim,giom->bgom", xf, w).reshape(B, C, m)
            y = torch.fft.irfft(yf, n=2 * L, dim=-1)[..., :L]
        return y.to(x.dtype)


class FNOBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, d=1, modes=48, groups=4, drop=0.05):
        super().__init__()
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.act = GELU()
        self.local = nn.Conv1d(c, c, 3, padding=d, dilation=d)
        self.spec = SpectralMix(c, modes, groups)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop)
        self.out = nn.Conv1d(c, c, 1)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.out.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.out.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        a = self.act(self.bn1(x))
        h = self.local(a)
        h = h + self.spec(a).to(h.dtype)
        h = self.out(self.drop(self.act(self.bn2(h))))
        return x + h


class FNONet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_len, c0=128, c1=192, c=256, dilations=(1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 1), modes=48, groups=4,
                 local_ch=8, hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Conv1d(4, c0, 15, padding=7)
        self.e0 = ResBlock(c0, 5, 1)
        self.d1 = Down(c0, c1)
        self.e1 = ResBlock(c1, 5, 1)
        self.d2 = Down(c1, c)
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[FNOBlock(c, d, modes, groups) for d in dilations])
        self.post = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(c), GELU())
        L2 = (input_len // 2) // 2
        self.attn = nn.Conv1d(c, 1, 1)
        self.pos_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 1, L2))
        self.local = nn.Conv1d(c, local_ch, 1)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(3 * c + local_ch * L2, hidden), GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.1),
                                  nn.Linear(hidden, 1))
        nn.init.constant_(self.head[-1].bias, math.log(math.expm1(2.7)))

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.e0(self.stem(x))
        h = self.e1(self.d1(h))
        h = self.blocks(self.d2(h))
        u = self.post(h)
        logits = self.attn(u).float() + self.pos_bias.float()
        w = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        pooled = (u.float() * w).sum(dim=-1)
        g = torch.cat([u.max(dim=-1).values.float(), u.mean(dim=-1).float()], dim=1)
        loc = self.local(u).flatten(1).float()
        feats = torch.cat([pooled, g, loc], dim=1).to(u.dtype)
        out = self.head(feats)
        return F.softplus(out.float()).reshape(-1)


def build_model(input_len):
    return FNONet(input_len)

    laid = laid_length(length, WIDTH, a5, a3)
    free = WIDTH - laid
    left = (free - torch.minimum(shift, free)).clamp(min=0).long()
    return onehot(arrange(codes, length, left, WIDTH, a5, a3))


def train_batch(codes, length, y, rng):
    g = torch.Generator(device=codes.device).manual_seed(int(rng.integers(2 ** 62)))
    shift = torch.randint(0, JITTER + 1, (len(length),), device=codes.device, generator=g)

        preds.append(net(_layout(codes, length, shift)).float().reshape(-1))
    return torch.stack(preds, 0).mean(0)

        return torch.sigmoid(1.702 * x) * x


class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, k=3, d=1, drop=0.05):
        super().__init__()
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, k, padding=d * (k // 2), dilation=d)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, 1)
        self.act = GELU()
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.conv1(self.act(self.bn1(x)))
        h = self.conv2(self.drop(self.act(self.bn2(h))))
        return x + h


class Down(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, cin, cout, k=5):
        super().__init__()
        self.f = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(cin), GELU(), nn.Conv1d(cin, cout, k, padding=k // 2), nn.MaxPool1d(2))

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.f(x)


class TiedCore(nn.Module):
    """Weight-tied iterative refinement: a cycle of dilated residual blocks whose convolutions are shared across
    cycles; each unrolled step has its own BatchNorms and a learned gain."""

    def __init__(self, c, dilations=(1, 2, 4, 8), cycles=3, drop=0.05):
        super().__init__()
        self.dilations = dilations
        self.cycles = cycles
        n = len(dilations)
        self.conv1 = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv1d(c, c, 3, padding=d, dilation=d) for d in dilations])
        self.conv2 = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv1d(c, c, 1) for _ in dilations])
        for m in self.conv2:
            nn.init.zeros_(m.weight)
            nn.init.zeros_(m.bias)
        steps = n * cycles
        self.bn1 = nn.ModuleList([nn.BatchNorm1d(c) for _ in range(steps)])
        self.bn2 = nn.ModuleList([nn.BatchNorm1d(c) for _ in range(steps)])
        self.gain = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(steps))
        self.act = GELU()
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        n = len(self.dilations)
        step = 0
        for _ in range(self.cycles):
            for j in range(n):
                h = self.conv1[j](self.act(self.bn1[step](x)))
                h = self.conv2[j](self.drop(self.act(self.bn2[step](h))))
                x = x + self.gain[step].to(h.dtype) * h
                step += 1
        return x


class PosReadout(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, length):
        super().__init__()
        self.post = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(c), GELU())
        self.attn = nn.Conv1d(c, 1, 1)
        self.pos_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 1, length))

    def forward(self, x):
        u = self.post(x)
        logits = self.attn(u).float() + self.pos_bias.float()
        w = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        uf = u.float()
        pooled = (uf * w).sum(dim=-1)
        return torch.cat([pooled, uf.max(dim=-1).values, uf.mean(dim=-1)], dim=1), u


class TiedRecurrentNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_len, c0=128, c1=192, c2=256, cycles=3, local_ch=8, hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        L1 = input_len // 2
        L2 = L1 // 2
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(4, c0, 15, padding=7), ResBlock(c0, 5, 1))
        self.d1 = Down(c0, c1)
        self.s1 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(c1, 3, 1), ResBlock(c1, 3, 2))
        self.d2 = Down(c1, c2)
        self.core = TiedCore(c2, (1, 2, 4, 8), cycles)
        self.r1 = PosReadout(c1, L1)
        self.r2 = PosReadout(c2, L2)
        self.local = nn.Conv1d(c2, local_ch, 1)
        nfeat = 3 * (c1 + c2) + local_ch * L2
        self.head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(nfeat, hidden), GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.1), nn.Linear(hidden, 1))
        nn.init.constant_(self.head[-1].bias, 2.5)

    def forward(self, x):
        h1 = self.s1(self.d1(self.stem(x)))
        h2 = self.core(self.d2(h1))
        f1, _ = self.r1(h1)
        f2, u2 = self.r2(h2)
        loc = self.local(u2).flatten(1).float()
        feats = torch.cat([f1, f2, loc], dim=1).to(h2.dtype)
        out = self.head(feats)
        return F.softplus(out.float()).reshape(-1)


def build_model(input_len):
    return TiedRecurrentNet(input_len)

# --- block: model ---
GAMMA = 1.7  # variance-preserving scale for the sigmoid-GELU on unit-normal input


class GELU(nn.Module):
    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.sigmoid(1.702 * x) * x


class ScaledGELU(nn.Module):
    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.sigmoid(1.702 * x) * x * GAMMA


class WSConv1d(nn.Conv1d):
    """Conv with scaled weight standardisation (computed in fp32) and a learned per-channel gain."""

    def __init__(self, cin, cout, k, dilation=1):
        super().__init__(cin, cout, k, padding=dilation * (k // 2), dilation=dilation)
        self.gain = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(cout, 1, 1))
        nn.init.kaiming_normal_(self.weight, nonlinearity='linear')
        nn.init.zeros_(self.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        w = self.weight.float()
        fan_in = w[0].numel()
        mean = w.mean(dim=(1, 2), keepdim=True)
        var = w.var(dim=(1, 2), keepdim=True, unbiased=False)
        w = (w - mean) * torch.rsqrt(var * fan_in + 1e-4) * self.gain.float()
        return F.conv1d(x, w.to(x.dtype), self.bias.to(x.dtype), self.stride, self.padding, self.dilation)


class NFBlock(nn.Module):
    """Normalizer-free pre-activation residual block: x + g * f(act(x / beta)), g initialised at zero."""

    def __init__(self, c, k=3, d=1, beta=1.0, drop=0.05):
        super().__init__()
        self.beta = beta
        self.act = ScaledGELU()
        self.conv1 = WSConv1d(c, c, k, d)
        self.conv2 = WSConv1d(c, c, 1)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop)
        self.skip_gain = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(()))

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.conv1(self.act(x / self.beta))
        h = self.conv2(self.drop(self.act(h)))
        return x + self.skip_gain.to(h.dtype) * h


def nf_stage(c, k, dilations, alpha=0.2):
    blocks = []
    for i, d in enumerate(dilations):
        beta = math.sqrt(1.0 + i * alpha * alpha)
        blocks.append(NFBlock(c, k, d, beta))
    return nn.Sequential(*blocks)


class NFDown(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, cin, cout, k=5):
        super().__init__()
        self.act = ScaledGELU()
        self.conv = WSConv1d(cin, cout, k)
        self.pool = nn.MaxPool1d(2)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.pool(self.conv(self.act(x)))


class NFPosReadout(nn.Module):
    """Attention pool with a learned per-position bias, plus max and mean; no batch statistics."""

    def __init__(self, c, length):
        super().__init__()
        self.act = GELU()
        self.attn = nn.Conv1d(c, 1, 1)
        self.pos_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 1, length))

    def forward(self, x):
        u = self.act(x)
        uf = u.float()
        logits = self.attn(u).float() + self.pos_bias.float()
        w = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        pooled = (uf * w).sum(dim=-1)
        return torch.cat([pooled, uf.max(dim=-1).values, uf.mean(dim=-1)], dim=1), u


class NFPyramid(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_len, c0=128, c1=128, c2=192, c3=256, local_ch=8, hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        L1 = input_len // 2
        L2 = L1 // 2
        L3 = L2 // 2
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(WSConv1d(4, c0, 15), NFBlock(c0, 5, 1))
        self.d1 = NFDown(c0, c1)
        self.s1 = nf_stage(c1, 3, (1, 2))
        self.d2 = NFDown(c1, c2)
        self.s2 = nf_stage(c2, 3, (1, 2, 4))
        self.d3 = NFDown(c2, c3)
        self.s3 = nf_stage(c3, 3, (1, 2, 4, 8))
        self.r1 = NFPosReadout(c1, L1)
        self.r2 = NFPosReadout(c2, L2)
        self.r3 = NFPosReadout(c3, L3)
        self.local = nn.Conv1d(c3, local_ch, 1)
        nfeat = 3 * (c1 + c2 + c3) + local_ch * L3
        self.feat_norm = nn.LayerNorm(nfeat)
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(nfeat, hidden)
        self.act = GELU()
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(0.1)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(hidden, 1)
        nn.init.constant_(self.fc2.bias, 2.5)

    def forward(self, x):
        h1 = self.s1(self.d1(self.stem(x)))
        h2 = self.s2(self.d2(h1))
        h3 = self.s3(self.d3(h2))
        f1, _ = self.r1(h1)
        f2, _ = self.r2(h2)
        f3, u3 = self.r3(h3)
        loc = self.local(u3).flatten(1).float()
        feats = torch.cat([f1, f2, f3, loc], dim=1)
        with torch.autocast(device_type=feats.device.type, enabled=False):
            feats = self.feat_norm(feats.float())
        h = self.drop(self.act(self.fc1(feats.to(h3.dtype))))
        out = self.fc2(h)
        return F.softplus(out.float()).reshape(-1)


def build_model(input_len):
    return NFPyramid(input_len)

    shift = torch.randint(0, JITTER + 1, (len(length),), device=codes.device, generator=g)

models.name: bilinear-cov-pool-dilres
models.hypothesis: Fragments are laid out against the 3' end with N padding to their left. After the trunk, the padded positions carry near-constant activations. These dominate the P Q^T / 154 Gram for short and median fragments (median 275 bp is only about 70 of 154 pooled positions). So the second-order statistics mostly encode length and padding, not motif co-occurrence. C54 matched its plain C25 trunk (0.7355 vs 0.7362), which is consistent with the readout adding no new information. Masking the projections to the fragment's own positions (including adaptors), and normalising by the true pooled length, makes the Gram a real co-occurrence statistic of the fragment's motifs. Length information stays available through the local positional features and the max/mean pools.
models.predicted_effect: Fold-0 R^2 rises about 1-2 noise floors above C54, to about 0.737-0.739, with the same cost.
models.change_summary: CovPool: zero out padded positions (mask from the one-hot, max-pooled by 4) and divide the Gram by the real pooled length.

class GELU(nn.Module):
    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.sigmoid(1.702 * x) * x


class DilBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, d, drop=0.05):
        super().__init__()
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, 3, padding=d, dilation=d)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, 1)
        self.act = GELU()
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.conv1(self.act(self.bn1(x)))
        h = self.conv2(self.drop(self.act(self.bn2(h))))
        return x + h


class CovPool(nn.Module):
    """Low-rank asymmetric second-order pooling over the fragment's own positions only: G = (P*m)(Q*m)^T / n, signed sqrt, LayerNorm."""

    def __init__(self, c, r=48):
        super().__init__()
        self.p = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(c, r, 1), nn.BatchNorm1d(r))
        self.q = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(c, r, 1), nn.BatchNorm1d(r))
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(r * r)
        self.r = r

    def forward(self, u, m):
        p = self.p(u)
        q = self.q(u)
        with torch.autocast(device_type=u.device.type, enabled=False):
            m = m.float()
            p = p.float() * m
            q = q.float() * m
            n = m.sum(dim=-1).clamp(min=1.0).reshape(-1, 1, 1)
            g = torch.bmm(p, q.transpose(1, 2)) / n
            g = g.flatten(1)
            g = torch.sign(g) * torch.sqrt(g.abs() + 1e-4)
            g = self.norm(g)
        return g


class CovNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_len, c1=128, c=256, dilations=(1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32), local_ch=8, rank=48, hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(4, c1, 15, padding=7), nn.BatchNorm1d(c1), GELU(), nn.MaxPool1d(2),
                                  nn.Conv1d(c1, c, 5, padding=2), nn.BatchNorm1d(c), GELU(), nn.MaxPool1d(2))
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[DilBlock(c, d) for d in dilations])
        self.post = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(c), GELU())
        L = (input_len // 2) // 2
        self.local = nn.Conv1d(c, local_ch, 1)
        self.cov = CovPool(c, rank)
        nfeat = 2 * c + local_ch * L + rank * rank
        self.head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(nfeat, hidden), GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.1), nn.Linear(hidden, 1))
        nn.init.constant_(self.head[-1].bias, 2.5)

    def forward(self, x):
        m = (x.float().sum(dim=1, keepdim=True) > 0).float()
        m = F.max_pool1d(m, 2)
        m = F.max_pool1d(m, 2)
        h = self.post(self.blocks(self.stem(x)))
        hf = h.float()
        g = torch.cat([hf.max(dim=-1).values, hf.mean(dim=-1)], dim=1)
        loc = self.local(h).flatten(1).float()
        cov = self.cov(h, m)
        feats = torch.cat([g, loc, cov], dim=1).to(h.dtype)
        out = self.head(feats)
        return F.softplus(out.float()).reshape(-1)


def build_model(input_len):
    return CovNet(input_len)

class GELU(nn.Module):
    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.sigmoid(1.702 * x) * x


class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, k=3, d=1, drop=0.05):
        super().__init__()
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, k, padding=d * (k // 2), dilation=d)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, 1)
        self.act = GELU()
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.conv1(self.act(self.bn1(x)))
        h = self.conv2(self.drop(self.act(self.bn2(h))))
        return x + h


class Down(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, cin, cout, k=5):
        super().__init__()
        self.f = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(cin), GELU(), nn.Conv1d(cin, cout, k, padding=k // 2), nn.MaxPool1d(2))

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.f(x)


class InitiationDensityNet(nn.Module):
    """Activity = log2 of the summed initiation rates of all 4-bp bins, times one global gain."""

    def __init__(self, input_len, c0=128, c1=192, c=256, dilations=(1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32), score_hidden=128):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(4, c0, 15, padding=7), ResBlock(c0, 5, 1))
        self.d1 = Down(c0, c1)
        self.s1 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(c1, 3, 1), ResBlock(c1, 3, 2))
        self.d2 = Down(c1, c)
        self.trunk = nn.Sequential(*[ResBlock(c, 3, d) for d in dilations])
        self.post = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(c), GELU())
        self.score = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv1d(c, score_hidden, 1), GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.05), nn.Conv1d(score_hidden, 1, 1))
        nn.init.normal_(self.score[-1].weight, std=0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.score[-1].bias)
        L = (input_len // 2) // 2
        self.pos_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, L))
        self.gain = nn.Linear(2 * c, 1)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.gain.weight)
        nn.init.constant_(self.gain.bias, -3.0)
        self.inv_ln2 = 1.0 / math.log(2.0)

    def forward(self, x):
        occ = (x.float().sum(dim=1, keepdim=True) > 0).float()
        occ = F.max_pool1d(F.max_pool1d(occ, 2), 2).squeeze(1)
        h = self.trunk(self.d2(self.s1(self.d1(self.stem(x)))))
        u = self.post(h)
        s = self.score(u).float().squeeze(1)
        L = min(s.shape[-1], occ.shape[-1], self.pos_bias.shape[-1])
        s = s[:, :L] + self.pos_bias[:, :L].float() - (1.0 - occ[:, :L]) * 1e4
        lse = torch.logsumexp(s, dim=-1) * self.inv_ln2
        uf = u.float()
        g = self.gain(torch.cat([uf.mean(dim=-1), uf.max(dim=-1).values], dim=1).to(self.gain.weight.dtype)).float().reshape(-1)
        return F.softplus(lse + g).reshape(-1)


def build_model(input_len):
    return InitiationDensityNet(input_len)

models.name: deformable-dilated-trunk
models.hypothesis: In C48 the offset convs are zero-initialised and trained at the full lr of 1e-3 with AdamW. Adam steps have a fixed size regardless of gradient scale, so the sampling positions can move by roughly a base per few hundred steps early on, while the projection weights are still forming. That drift is noise across the 6 stacked blocks. DCNv2 trains offsets with a 0.1 lr multiplier for this reason. Multiplying the offset output by 0.1 makes each Adam step move the positions 10x less, so the offsets settle into consistent motif-spacing shifts. It needs no per-parameter optimizer groups and costs no compute. This is a family-specific edit, not one of the width or settings changes already run on any lineage.
models.predicted_effect: Fold-0 R^2 per fragment about 0.7405-0.742, up to 1 noise floor over C48. The early curve should be at least as stable as C48's, at the same GPU-hours (about 3.6).

    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.sigmoid(1.702 * x) * x


class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, k=3, d=1, drop=0.05):
        super().__init__()
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, k, padding=d * (k // 2), dilation=d)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, 1)
        self.act = GELU()
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.conv1(self.act(self.bn1(x)))
        h = self.conv2(self.drop(self.act(self.bn2(h))))
        return x + h


class Down(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, cin, cout, k=5):
        super().__init__()
        self.f = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(cin), GELU(), nn.Conv1d(cin, cout, k, padding=k // 2), nn.MaxPool1d(2))

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.f(x)


class DeformBlock(nn.Module):
    """Pre-activation residual block whose k-tap dilated conv samples at learned fractional offsets (DCNv2-style)."""

    OFFSET_SCALE = 0.1  # DCNv2-style damping of offset learning

    def __init__(self, c, d, k=3, drop=0.05):
        super().__init__()
        self.k, self.d = k, d
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.act = GELU()
        self.off = nn.Conv1d(c, k, 3, padding=1)
        self.msk = nn.Conv1d(c, k, 3, padding=1)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.off.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.off.bias)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.msk.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.msk.bias)
        self.proj = nn.Conv1d(c * k, c, 1)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, 1)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.act(self.bn1(x))
        B, C, L = h.shape
        K = self.k
        off = self.off(h).float() * self.OFFSET_SCALE
        m = 2.0 * torch.sigmoid(self.msk(h).float())
        taps = (torch.arange(K, device=h.device, dtype=torch.float32) - K // 2) * self.d
        base = torch.arange(L, device=h.device, dtype=torch.float32)
        pos = base.view(1, 1, L) + taps.view(1, K, 1) + off
        p0 = torch.floor(pos)
        w1 = pos - p0
        w0 = 1.0 - w1
        p1 = p0 + 1.0
        v0m = ((p0 >= 0) & (p0 <= L - 1)).float()
        v1m = ((p1 >= 0) & (p1 <= L - 1)).float()
        i0 = p0.clamp(0, L - 1).long().reshape(B, 1, K * L).expand(B, C, K * L)
        i1 = p1.clamp(0, L - 1).long().reshape(B, 1, K * L).expand(B, C, K * L)
        a0 = (w0 * v0m * m).reshape(B, 1, K * L).to(h.dtype)
        a1 = (w1 * v1m * m).reshape(B, 1, K * L).to(h.dtype)
        s = torch.gather(h, 2, i0) * a0 + torch.gather(h, 2, i1) * a1
        s = s.reshape(B, C, K, L).reshape(B, C * K, L)
        h = self.proj(s)
        h = self.conv2(self.drop(self.act(self.bn2(h))))
        return x + h


class DeformNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_len, c0=128, c1=192, c=256, dilations=(1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32), local_ch=8, hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Conv1d(4, c0, 15, padding=7)
        self.e0 = ResBlock(c0, 5, 1)
        self.d1 = Down(c0, c1)
        self.e1 = ResBlock(c1, 5, 1)
        self.d2 = Down(c1, c)
        self.trunk = nn.Sequential(*[DeformBlock(c, d) for d in dilations])
        self.post = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(c), GELU())
        L = (input_len // 2) // 2
        self.attn = nn.Conv1d(c, 1, 1)
        self.pos_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 1, L))
        self.local = nn.Conv1d(c, local_ch, 1)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(3 * c + local_ch * L, hidden), GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.1), nn.Linear(hidden, 1))

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.e0(self.stem(x))
        h = self.e1(self.d1(h))
        h = self.trunk(self.d2(h))
        u = self.post(h)
        logits = self.attn(u).float() + self.pos_bias.float()
        w = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        pooled = (u.float() * w).sum(dim=-1)
        g = torch.cat([u.max(dim=-1).values.float(), u.mean(dim=-1).float()], dim=1)
        loc = self.local(u).flatten(1).float()
        feats = torch.cat([pooled, g, loc], dim=1).to(u.dtype)
        out = self.head(feats)
        return F.softplus(out.float()).reshape(-1)


def build_model(input_len):
    return DeformNet(input_len)

models.hypothesis: A stem built as a biophysical binding model should give the trunk cleaner, calibrated motif evidence than a free linear k15 conv. It scans 160 PWM-like filters on both strands with tied weights, keeps the strands as separate channels, turns energies into occupancies with sigmoid(energy + learned log-concentration), and average-pools the occupancies as expected site counts. This should help a 3M-fragment task whose activity is mostly additive in TF sites.

# --- block: model ---
class GELU(nn.Module):
    def forward(self, x):
        return torch.sigmoid(1.702 * x) * x


class OccupancyStem(nn.Module):
    """Biophysical motif scan: each filter is a PWM scored on both strands with tied weights; energies -> occupancy
    via sigmoid(E + log-concentration). Strands kept as separate channels (orientation stays visible)."""

    def __init__(self, n_motif=160, k=15):
        super().__init__()
        self.k = k
        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(n_motif, 4, k) * (1.0 / math.sqrt(4 * k)) * 2.0)
        self.bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(n_motif))
        self.log_conc = nn.Parameter(torch.full((n_motif,), -1.0))
        self.strand_gain = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(1, 2 * n_motif, 1))

    def forward(self, x):
        w = self.weight.to(x.dtype)
        w_rc = torch.flip(w, dims=(1, 2))
        b = (self.bias + self.log_conc).to(x.dtype)
        e_f = F.conv1d(x, w, b, padding=self.k // 2)
        e_r = F.conv1d(x, w_rc, b, padding=self.k // 2)
        occ = torch.sigmoid(torch.cat([e_f, e_r], dim=1).float()).to(x.dtype)
        return occ * self.strand_gain.to(x.dtype)


class ResBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, k=3, d=1, drop=0.05):
        super().__init__()
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, k, padding=d * (k // 2), dilation=d)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(c)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv1d(c, c, 1)
        self.act = GELU()
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.bias)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = self.conv1(self.act(self.bn1(x)))
        h = self.conv2(self.drop(self.act(self.bn2(h))))
        return x + h


class PosReadout(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, length):
        super().__init__()
        self.post = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(c), GELU())
        self.attn = nn.Conv1d(c, 1, 1)
        self.pos_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 1, length))

    def forward(self, x):
        u = self.post(x)
        logits = self.attn(u).float() + self.pos_bias.float()
        w = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        uf = u.float()
        pooled = (uf * w).sum(dim=-1)
        return torch.cat([pooled, uf.max(dim=-1).values, uf.mean(dim=-1)], dim=1), u


class ThermoNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_len, n_motif=160, c1=192, c=256, dilations=(1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32), local_ch=8, hidden=256):
        super().__init__()
        L1 = input_len // 2
        L2 = L1 // 2
        self.stem = OccupancyStem(n_motif, 15)
        self.mix = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(2 * n_motif), nn.Conv1d(2 * n_motif, c1, 1), nn.AvgPool1d(2))
        self.s1 = nn.Sequential(ResBlock(c1, 5, 1), ResBlock(c1, 3, 2))
        self.down = nn.Sequential(nn.BatchNorm1d(c1), GELU(), nn.Conv1d(c1, c, 5, padding=2), nn.MaxPool1d(2))
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[ResBlock(c, 3, d) for d in dilations])
        self.r1 = PosReadout(c1, L1)
        self.r2 = PosReadout(c, L2)
        self.local = nn.Conv1d(c, local_ch, 1)
        nfeat = 3 * (c1 + c) + local_ch * L2
        self.head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(nfeat, hidden), GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.1), nn.Linear(hidden, 1))
        nn.init.constant_(self.head[-1].bias, 2.5)

    def forward(self, x):
        h1 = self.s1(self.mix(self.stem(x)))
        h2 = self.blocks(self.down(h1))
        f1, _ = self.r1(h1)
        f2, u2 = self.r2(h2)
        loc = self.local(u2).flatten(1).float()
        feats = torch.cat([f1, f2, loc], dim=1).to(h2.dtype)
        out = self.head(feats)
        return F.softplus(out.float()).reshape(-1)


def build_model(input_len):
    return ThermoNet(input_len)

    a5, a3 = to_codes(ADAPTOR5, codes.device), to_codes(ADAPTOR3, codes.device)
